description: LIVE: move the account's free cash from one venue to another (Hyperliquid, Polymarket, Lighter), exactly like Transfer in the Felix app. Felix signs it; no owner signature. Only the owner's own venue accounts and Trading wallet are paid, and open orders, positions and running agents keep their cash. Give exactly one of amount_usd or all_free_cash:true. Reuse the same idempotency_key to retry: it always returns the same transfer, never a second one. Most transfers finish in seconds to a few minutes (Lighter withdrawals can take longer). Set wait_seconds to wait for the result, or poll get_venue_transfer. Never start another transfer while one is sending or needs review.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID. Omit for the active account.

all_free_cash.description: true moves all free cash on from_venue. Use instead of amount_usd.

amount_usd.description: USDC amount, at most six decimal places. Omit only with all_free_cash:true.

idempotency_key.description: Required, 8 to 128 printable characters. One key per transfer; reuse it after any timeout.

wait_seconds.description: Optional: wait up to this many seconds (0 to 120) for a final state. Default 0.

name: transfer_between_venues
